messages:
alice-support: @here Nebula is reporting 503s for hosted inference starting ~07:12 UTC. They say errors spike during model swap to model-redwood-v2-quant. Attaching relevant gateway log excerpt and their request id. Can oncall / infra take? :rotating_light:

ben-oncall: looking. I see retries from their tenant id, 07:11:58 -> 07:12:06 repeated. Backend returned 500 from upstream worker. Throwing this into triage channel.

cara-engineering: grabbing logs from the upstream nodes serving v2-quant, looks like containers for node pool gpu-pool-7 restarted. Kernel: "segfault" followed by OOM-related cgroup eviction in dmesg.

alice-support: here is the customer's request id they sent: req=nebula-req-9f3a. Gateway log snippet:
```
07:12:05 GET /v1/generate req=nebula-req-9f3a tenant=nebula status=503 upstream=worker-273 err="upstream error"
07:12:06 POST /v1/generate req=nebula-req-9f3a tenant=nebula status=503 upstream=worker-273 err="worker exit(137)"
07:12:06 worker-273 container exited: SIGSEGV / OOM?
```

dave-ml: v2-quant had a recent kernel swap that reduced precision. We pushed a hot quant change yesterday at 02:30. Could be an edge-case with attention kernel and nvtx pinned mem growth.

ben-oncall: immediate mitigations applied: routed Nebula to model-redwood-v2-fp16 (fallback) and enabled strict connection timeouts. That reduced errors to baseline for them. Rolling out full tenant fallback for all affected tenants now.

eva-platform: re-route policy live for Nebula and 3 other tenants. Also temporarily disabled autoscaler for gpu-pool-7 to avoid thrashing while we investigate.

cara-engineering: collecting core dump from worker-273 and starting reproducer on a dev GPU. Repro attempt: run multi-context synthetic workload with batch=8, seq=4096, kv-prefetch enabled, quantized kernels. If repro, we should be able to trigger OOM or segfault within ~30s.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by cara-engineering to previous quant profile: model-redwood-v2-quant -> model-redwood-v2-quant@2026-03-16T23:45Z (initiated).

frank-billing: FYI CS asked about credits for impacted queries. If fallback to fp16 increased cost, we should track delta and offer credit. Will open billing ticket once we have scope.

ben-oncall: short term: fallback + per-tenant routing is live. Medium term: cara, dave to reproduce and send kernel patch or config change. Also want memory accounting added to runtime logs for the kernel path.

cara-engineering: repro succeeded locally with synthetic workload, looks like KV cache growth with quant kernels doesn't trim when context swaps happen. Crash stack points to attention kernel + cudaMalloc failures. Working on small patch to early-free ephemeral buffers.

alice-support: updated Nebula customer that we routed to fallback model and are investigating root cause. They requested ETA for fix, told them "investigating, likely hours".

dave-ml: dropping a test PR with guard for kv-prefetch trimming and a config toggle to disable the new quant kernel at runtime for rollback without model swap.

ben-oncall: next actions: 1) cara PR for early-free (test + canary), 2) dave PR for runtime toggle, 3) eva to monitor gpu-pool-7 for thrash. I'll coordinate a postmortem template after we stabilize.

frank-billing: opened BILL-2319 to track customer impact and credits.

alice-support: closing immediate customer alert; will keep thread updated. Marking as P1 until patch lands. :thumbsup:
